recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, warm-toned portrait of a man in a plaid shirt leaning over a red textured surface, featuring a vertical sidebar of text and a right-aligned typographic lockup combining a heavy condensed sans-serif with a delicate script.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face as the primary focal point against a blurred background
Contrast between the heavy yellow block lettering and the white cursive script
Vertical black sidebar balancing the right-aligned main text
Warm skin tones harmonizing with the red foreground and yellow accents
coreInvariants: Plaid pattern on the subject's clothing
Low-angle perspective leaning into the camera
Triadic color scheme of red, yellow, and black/white

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Man positioned centrally, filling the upper two-thirds of the frame, leaning forward with arms crossed.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright yellow text in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down the arm to the foreground, then up to the main title text, and finally to the vertical sidebar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is tightly packed with the subject and foreground elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and skin tones in the portrait.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red in the foreground and black in the sidebar.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red and yellow; medium value range with soft shadows on the face.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed geometric sans-serif and fluid copperplate script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Ultra-condensed, high-waisted, uniform stroke weight, flat terminals.
Secondary text: Slanted, connected cursive with varying stroke thickness.
Sidebar text: Small, spaced-out sans-serif and script mix.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the primary text has a distinct vertical stretch.
The script 'M' and 'L' have exaggerated flourishes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of rigid, vertical industrial sans-serif with organic, flowing script.
graphicDevices: Vertical black bar on the left edge
Drop shadow on yellow text to improve legibility against background

preserve: Condensed nature of the main text
avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ultra-condensed, heavy feel of the primary text.
Matches the informal, flowing nature of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man with short dark hair wearing a black and white plaid flannel shirt, leaning his arms on the hood of a red truck. Soft outdoor lighting, shallow depth of field. A solid black vertical stripe occupies the far left 5% of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked, ultra-condensed yellow sans-serif text in the upper right. Below it, add a white flowing script subtitle with a thin black outline. Add small vertical white and yellow text inside the black sidebar on the left.

verificationChecks: Is the sidebar black with vertical text?
Is the man wearing a plaid shirt?
Is the foreground a textured red surface?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Any specific logos or record label branding
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script text is legible against the background.
Check that the yellow text is vertically aligned.
Verify the black sidebar does not obscure the subject's face.
Confirm the color palette remains warm and cohesive.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject in plaid + red foreground + black vertical sidebar + condensed yellow display type + script subtitle.
